title: OMR official planning evidence ledger
methodology: MITO records only the jurisdiction, decision, survey, road and programme facts visible in official government orders, CMDA rules, indexes, meeting minutes, approval letters and office-copy maps. A planning record is linked to a current registration village only when the crosswalk is unambiguous. No record is treated as price, title evidence or a village-wide land-use statement.
coverageCaveat: A record may establish planning-area membership for a named village or describe a specific survey, layout, road or planning decision. Planning-area membership does not prove parcel zoning, approval, title or value; site-specific records do not apply village-wide.

records.surveyReference: S.No.23/24 of Seevaram Village; proposal also spans listed Neelankarai surveys
records.planningConstraint: The letter approves planning permission for a 209-dwelling residential group development, states that a local-body building permit is still required, and expressly does not confirm ownership or title.
records.locationEvidence: The signed CMDA approval letter directly names Seevaram village and S.No.23/24; MITO has not digitised or independently reconciled the approved-plan boundary.
records.summary: CMDA issued planning permission for a specific residential group development that includes S.No.23/24 of Seevaram village.
records.scopeCaveat: This is site-specific planning permission, not a building permit, title finding, village-wide approval or land-value observation.
